Hiring Process - Interview Stages
Candidates go through 5 stages: resume screening, technical round 1, technical round 2, managerial round and HR round.

Hiring Process - Offer
The offer letter is sent within 5 working days after the final round. A candidate has 7 days to accept the offer.

Hiring Process - Referral Bonus
Employees who refer a candidate that joins get a referral bonus of 25,000 rupees, paid after the new joiner completes 90 days.

Hiring Process - Joining
New joiners receive a laptop within one day of joining. HR sends the onboarding checklist two days before the joining date.

HR - Working Hours
Core working hours at Zorvex are 10 AM to 4 PM. Employees must complete 8 hours a day, and the office is open Monday to Friday.

HR - Work From Home
Employees can work from home up to 2 days a week with manager approval. Fully remote work needs approval from the HR director.

HR - Onboarding
On the first day, new joiners complete HR formalities, collect their ID card and attend an orientation session. A buddy is assigned for the first 30 days.

HR - Performance Reviews
Performance reviews happen twice a year, in April and October. Ratings are on a scale of 1 to 5, and a rating of 4 or above makes an employee eligible for a bonus.

HR - Notice Period
The standard notice period is 60 days. Employees in the first 6 months of service have a notice period of 30 days.

Leave Policy - Casual Leave
Every employee at Zorvex Technologies gets 12 days of casual leave per year. Casual leave must be applied at least one day in advance and cannot be carried forward.

Leave Policy - Earned Leave
Employees earn 1.5 days of earned leave per month, which is 18 days per year. Up to 30 days of earned leave can be carried forward to the next year.

Leave Policy - Sick Leave
Employees get 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days.

Leave Policy - Maternity and Paternity Leave
Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave. Paternity leave is 10 working days and must be taken within 3 months of the child's birth.

Leave Policy - Applying for Leave
Leave must be applied for in the Zorvex PeopleHub portal and approved by the reporting manager. An unapproved absence of more than 3 days is treated as unauthorized absence.

Medical Policy - Health Insurance
Every employee and their family is covered under a family floater health insurance of 5 lakh rupees. Parents can be added at an extra cost.

Medical Policy - Claims
Cashless treatment is available at network hospitals. For other hospitals, reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 days of discharge.

Medical Policy - Long Medical Leave
If an employee needs more than 10 days of sick leave, they can apply for long medical leave of up to 60 days. A doctor's certificate and HR approval are required.

Medical Policy - Maternity Cover
Hospitalization for childbirth is covered up to 75,000 rupees. The maternity cover starts after 9 months of service.

Medical Policy - Health Checkup
Every employee gets one free annual health checkup at a partner clinic. Dental and eye treatment are not covered by the insurance.
